**Paper Under Review: "Mathematical Reasoning via Problem-Solving Data in Continued Pre-Training"**
The paper under review presents a rigorous empirical investigation into how problem-solving data (vs. general math texts) affects LLM reasoning, specifically isolating the effects of Continued Pre-Training (CPT) versus Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT). Its strengths are substantial:

The weaknesses identified are primarily methodological concerns that could be addressed with additional experiments but do not undermine the fundamental validity of the claims:
